title: Can COP31 Be the Turning Point in Global Climate Diplomacy? Dual Presidency and Resolving Consensus Gridlock
content: The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) arrives at a defining moment in human history. Following the findings of the first Global Stocktake (GST) and the establishment of the New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) on climate finance, the global community faces a stark reality: current commitments are insufficient to limit global warming to the critical 1.5°C threshold.
